story_zh: 从前，一位善良的国王热爱古典文化。据说，他每天朗读经典，欣赏传统武术如太极拳。多亏他的智慧，国家充满光明。他常说：“人生如棋，每一步都象征命运。”他的精神流传至今，成为我们学习的榜样。
story_pinyin: Cóngqián, yī wèi shànliáng de guówáng rè'ài gǔdiǎn wénhuà. Jùshuō, tā měitiān lǎngdú jīngdiǎn, xīnshǎng chuántǒng wǔshù rú tàijíquán. Duōkuī tā de zhìhuì, guójiā chōngmǎn guāngmíng. Tā cháng shuō: “Rénshēng rú qí, měi yī bù dōu xiàngzhēng mìngyùn.” Tā de jīngshén liúchuán zhìjīn, chéngwéi wǒmen xuéxí de bǎngyàng.
story_en: Once upon a time, a kind-hearted king loved classical culture. It is said that he read classics aloud every day and appreciated traditional martial arts like Tai Chi. Thanks to his wisdom, the country was full of brightness. He often said, "Life is like chess, every move symbolizes fate." His spirit has spread to this day, becoming a model for us to learn from.
